content.short: Superchain Faucet provides up to 1 ETH daily for test networks on the Superchain.
content.description: Superchain Faucet offers developers free testnet ETH to test their applications. Access to testnet funds is secured by authenticating your on-chain identity—either through the Optimist NFT or by logging in with your GitHub account. Once verified, you can claim up to 1 ETH every 24 hours to support ongoing development and debugging. The faucet currently supports OP Goerli, with Base Goerli support coming soon.
content.meta: Superchain Faucet provides funds up to 1 ETH every 24 hours on test networks. Discover Superchain Faucet and other Infrastructure Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
